percentages.title: Percentages - Concept, Formulas & Short Tricks
keyFormulas: Consumption Reduction = [r / (100 + r)] × 100% when price increases by r%
percentages.keyConcepts: Understand percentage as a fraction out of 100. Master base-value shifting and multiplier methods (e.g., 25% increase = 1.25x).

profit-and-loss.title: Profit & Loss - Complete Concepts & Shortcut Tricks
keyFormulas: Marked Price & Discount: SP = MP × [(100 - Discount %) / 100]
profit-and-loss.keyConcepts: Cost Price (CP) is always 100% baseline. Profit or Loss is calculated on CP, whereas Discount is calculated on Marked Price (MP).

ratio-and-proportion.title: Ratio & Proportion - Fundamentals & Quick Rules
keyFormulas: Mean Proportional between a and b = √(a × b)
If a:b = c:d, then a × d = b × c (Product of extremes = Product of means)
ratio-and-proportion.keyConcepts: Use constant multiplier x to represent components as ax, bx. Equal ratios can be combined by finding LCM of common terms.

time-and-work.title: Time & Work - Efficiency & LCM Method Shortcuts
keyFormulas: If A takes D1 days and B takes D2 days, Together Time = (D1 × D2) / (D1 + D2)
time-and-work.keyConcepts: Assume Total Work = LCM of given days. Calculate daily efficiency units to quickly solve complex joint-work problems.

speed-and-distance.title: Speed, Time & Distance - Relative Speed & Train Problems
keyFormulas: Average Speed (equal distance) = (2 × S1 × S2) / (S1 + S2)
speed-and-distance.keyConcepts: When two trains cross each other, total distance crossed is the sum of both train lengths. Adjust speed based on direction.

reading-comprehension.title: Verbal Ability - Reading Comprehension Strategies
keyFormulas: Skim for main idea → Scan for keywords → Infer tone and author intent
Watch for transition contrast words: However, Nevertheless, Yet, Conversely
reading-comprehension.keyConcepts: Identify paragraph structure, distinguish stated facts from author inferences, and eliminate extreme options.

syllogisms.title: Logical Reasoning - Syllogism Venn Diagram Rules
keyFormulas: All A are B → A ⊂ B
Some A are B → A ∩ B ≠ ∅
No A is B → A ∩ B = ∅
syllogisms.keyConcepts: Draw minimal overlap Venn diagrams. A conclusion is valid ONLY if it holds true in ALL possible Venn diagram representations.
